cases.title: reuses the hook host target while invalidating changed inputs
cases.reason: Actual host-built hook cache reuses without Cargo and invalidates source, release-version and cross-target changes.

cases.title: reuses restored builds only while all embedded inputs and the release version match
cases.reason: Real filesystem content fingerprints ignore timestamps while refusing missing output/stamp, version drift and changed inputs.

cases.title: reduces a prerelease to the numeric version Windows can record
cases.reason: PE numeric version mapping accepts prereleases and rejects malformed/out-of-range fields.

cases.title: embeds publisher, release version, icon and an unelevated application manifest
cases.reason: Real compiled PE inspection protects publisher/version/icon/unelevated manifest and static runtime dependencies.

cases.title: fails closed when the Windows launcher cannot be compiled on this host
cases.reason: Real cross-host CLI refuses silently skipped native compilation.

cases.title: preserves a multiline argument from PowerShell through the native launcher
cases.reason: Actual PowerShell-to-Rust-to-Node launch preserves multiline argv and strips unsafe Node options.

cases.title: cross-compiles only the architectures the orcad template ships
cases.reason: Architecture selection maps supported Node names to correct Rust triples and rejects unsupported ones.

cases.title: runs a server profile CLI on pinned Node with argv and profile intact
cases.reason: Real configured server launcher preserves profile and free-text argv while clearing inherited desktop/runtime environment.

cases.title: survives an inherited environment block containing PATH and Path
cases.reason: Actual duplicate-key environment block remains launchable through the native CreateProcess boundary.

rationale: Retain native Windows executable integration and byte/identity/cache checks; platform-gated cases run only on appropriate hosts.

cases.title: reuses the exact prepared %s candidate under pinned Node
cases.reason: Exact candidate bytes are copied only after pinned-Node preparation and execution of the real probe script.

cases.title: declines reuse without same-host opt-in and pinned runtime: %j
cases.reason: Opt-in, platform, host architecture and absolute runtime prerequisites must reject reuse before spawning.

cases.title: declines missing, corrupt, wrong-architecture candidates and an unverified runtime
cases.reason: PE machine, candidate existence and pinned-runtime checksum gate reuse before loading.

cases.title: declines failed loading or invalid probe results: %j
cases.reason: Probe status, timeout, output truncation and exact acknowledgement must all be valid.

cases.title: does not load the candidate after failed Node preparation: %j
cases.reason: Failed runtime preparation cannot proceed to loading the native candidate.

cases.title: declines probe spawn exceptions
cases.reason: Spawn exceptions degrade to cold compilation rather than crash the selection path.

cases.title: the probe rejects invalid currentUserSid results: %j
cases.reason: Executes actual probe source with invalid SID results and verifies rejection before success acknowledgement.

cases.title: the builder retains real compilation unless reuse succeeds: %s
cases.reason: Builder falls back to actual compilation orchestration across distinct failed reuse reasons and skips it only for validated reuse.

cases.title: standalone compilation rejects unsupported architectures and non-Windows hosts
cases.reason: Unsupported architectures and hosts fail before invoking node-gyp.

cases.title: the cold path fails closed on %s
cases.reason: Cold build refuses failed compiler, missing output and wrong-machine artifact without installing output.

rationale: Retain native security-addon cache trust and fallback compilation boundaries; probe source is executed to validate its runtime acknowledgement checks.

cases.title: rewrites only the version declaration
cases.reason: Only the intended version declaration changes; surrounding download expression is preserved.

cases.title: compares numerically, not as text
cases.reason: Two-digit patch bump is ordered numerically rather than lexicographically.

cases.title: leaves the same or a newer version in place
cases.reason: Equal and newer deployed versions cannot be downgraded.

cases.title: fails loudly when the declaration moved or the version is malformed
cases.reason: Missing declaration and invalid semantic version reject before rewriting source.

rationale: Retain version edit scope and numeric monotonicity to prevent stale release reruns downgrading APK links.

cases.title: enforces new casts without changing full lint in %s
cases.reason: Real Oxlint runs nested config/mobile scopes and demonstrates only added cast diagnostics gate.

cases.title: exempts the SAFETY: directive from the untyped scan's unused-directive warning
cases.reason: Real untyped scan produces a warning the casting-specific scan owns, and the classifier recognizes it.

cases.title: rejects a casting suppression on an added line that omits the SAFETY: rationale
cases.reason: Added casting directives need SAFETY rationale while unchanged directives do not gate.

cases.title: catches a trailing casting suppression that abuts a string literal
cases.reason: Trailing comment directly after a string still reaches the safety-rationale scanner.

rationale: Retain real lint integration plus changed-line suppression policy tests.

cases.title: parses added and replaced hunk ranges while ignoring deletions
cases.reason: Independent hunk examples distinguish additions/replacements from deletions.

cases.title: matches diagnostics that overlap any added line
cases.reason: Line overlap examples cover inclusive edges, gaps and later disjoint hunks.

cases.title: normalizes absolute diagnostic paths before matching
cases.reason: Absolute diagnostic path normalization reaches the relative changed-file inventory.

cases.title: lets the untyped scan discover nested configs instead of pinning the root config
cases.reason: Untyped invocation must discover nested configs to avoid enforcing root-only rules on mobile.

cases.title: runs the focused plugin config the repo-wide audit enforces, minus the cycle rule
cases.reason: Focused rule invocation preserves expected rule coverage and explicit cycle exemption.

cases.title: leaves Cloud source to the independent Cloud quality checks
cases.reason: Independent cloud source gates remain outside root lint scope.

cases.title: retains rename subtraction only within the included scope: %s
cases.reason: Real renamed Git files remove added-line debt only when their source belonged to the lint scope.

cases.title: treats a verbatim contiguous block from the base as moved
cases.reason: Contiguous base block is correctly exempt after a move.

cases.title: ignores indentation and whitespace changes from the move
cases.reason: Indentation-only changes do not invalidate moved-code evidence.

cases.title: does not exempt a genuinely new violation
cases.reason: Unrelated new source remains subject to diagnostics.

cases.title: does not exempt a block that is only partly present in the base
cases.reason: Partial overlap cannot hide a newly introduced violation.

cases.title: tolerates a few lines appended inside the moved block
cases.reason: Small appended dependencies preserve exemption for a mostly moved block.

cases.title: does not exempt when the anchor line is absent from the base
cases.reason: Missing initial anchor must refuse a moved-code exemption.

cases.title: does not exempt when most of the block is absent from the base
cases.reason: Mostly new blocks cannot borrow an exemption from one old line.

cases.title: ignores blank lines when matching
cases.reason: Blank lines do not create false moved-code changes.

cases.title: never exempts an empty highlight
cases.reason: Empty diagnostics cannot manufacture an exemption.

cases.title: reads the base text of a file that was renamed away
cases.reason: Real Git renamed-away source remains available for moved-code comparison.

cases.title: keeps source boundaries across batches, missing files, and multibyte contents
cases.reason: Real batched Git reads preserve file boundaries, absent files, CRLF and UTF-8 byte lengths.

cases.title: reads filenames containing newlines
cases.reason: Real newline filenames use the compatible per-file Git fallback.

cases.title: exempts a suppression the root scan cannot resolve
cases.reason: A directive for an unloaded plugin is classified for the scan that owns it.

cases.title: still reports an unused directive for a rule the root scan does load
cases.reason: A loaded native rule cannot hide an unused directive.

cases.title: ignores diagnostics that are not unused-directive warnings
cases.reason: Unrelated diagnostics cannot masquerade as unused-directive exceptions.

cases.title: rejects unit-support imports in production source: %s
cases.reason: Real lint bans unit-support imports in production through import/reexport/dynamic/relative forms.

cases.title: allows unit-support imports from the existing test convention: %s
cases.reason: Real lint permits the same imports only under existing test filename conventions.

cases.title: accepts a used Doctor directive only through its loaded scan
cases.reason: Used Doctor suppression is checked only by the scan loading that rule.

cases.title: keeps an unused Doctor directive failing in its loaded scan
cases.reason: Unused Doctor directive remains a failure in its owning scan.

cases.title: does not hide unused native rules in a mixed directive
cases.reason: Mixed native and unloaded-plugin directives cannot hide native warnings.

cases.title: recognizes a standalone directive containing only Doctor rules
cases.reason: Multiple explicit Doctor rules can be delegated together to their owning scan.

cases.title: keeps adjacent native directive warnings visible
cases.reason: Adjacent comment spans preserve native-rule diagnostic visibility in either order.

cases.title: leaves used native directives to the scan that loads them
cases.reason: Used native directives remain owned by the loaded scan across multibyte offsets.

cases.title: does not exempt unused Doctor rules together with unloaded native rules
cases.reason: Mixed unused Doctor and unloaded native rules are not fully exempted.

cases.title: keeps blanket unused directives visible in the Doctor scan
cases.reason: Blanket directives cannot claim a plugin-specific exemption.

rationale: Retain changed-line matching, real Git rename/blob reads and real lint-directive boundary coverage.

cases.title: lets the named importer use the entry and the folder use itself
cases.reason: Named owners may reach the designated entry and compatibility code may use itself.

cases.title: rejects other importers and deep imports, including renderer aliases
cases.reason: Unauthorized and deep imports reject including renderer aliases.

cases.title: resolves renderer aliases only in renderer files
cases.reason: Renderer aliases cannot accidentally claim mobile imports.

cases.title: lets tests outside the folder use only the entry
cases.reason: Outside tests may use compatibility entry points without deep private imports.

cases.title: rejects deep imports with escaped folder names: %s
cases.reason: Unicode/hex/identity/newline escapes cannot hide a deep import path from parsing.

cases.title: checks const-bound loaders and dot segments
cases.reason: Const-bound loaders and normalized dot segments remain guarded.

cases.title: checks imports inherited from a compatibility folder in the file path
cases.reason: Relative imports inherit the folder path when the source filename itself contains the compatibility name.

cases.title: rejects a folder-level import now that no index exists
cases.reason: Folder-level import cannot bypass designated entry modules.

cases.title: keeps parse failures fatal for candidate files
cases.reason: Invalid candidate syntax is fatal rather than silently skipped.

rationale: Retain parser-backed compatibility boundaries, escaped specifiers, local loaders and candidate parse failure checks.

cases.title: orders numerically and skips prerelease tags
cases.reason: Consolidated into explicit patch/minor/major numeric examples with prerelease exclusion.

cases.title: selects numerically without changing %i Git tag strings
cases.reason: Generated count sweep uses expectedLatest, a second implementation of the production algorithm; concrete frozen-input examples retain immutability and numeric coverage.

cases.title: preserves tie spelling, numeric fallback and invalid-tag admission
cases.reason: Consolidated explicit spelling/tie/invalid/overflow behavior into independent expected fixtures; sparse-list admission remains a focused case.

cases.title: selects the same latest spelling across ordinary version namespaces and repeated calls
cases.reason: Randomized namespace sweep compares two copied algorithms; retained explicit cases also follow each call with a lower-version-only call to detect stale selection state.

cases.title: passes a bump that lists the newest release version, reporting rollback as info
cases.reason: Real Git tags and working source prove newest stable release upgrade/rollback evaluation.

cases.title: fails when the working tree drops the newest release version
cases.reason: Real current protocol source missing the newest release version fails with concrete required upgrade support.

cases.title: refuses to pass silently without release tags
cases.reason: Tagless stable baseline cannot silently skip the gate.

cases.title: honors an explicit release ref
cases.reason: Explicit release ref bypasses default newest-tag selection and evaluates that actual protocol source.

rationale: Replace copied selector oracle and generated equivalence sweeps with explicit expected numeric ordering, frozen input, fresh-call, malformed-tag and sparse-list fixtures; keep real Git protocol checks.

cases.title: counts tests/ errors per file and ignores rows from other workspaces
cases.reason: Compiler diagnostic fixtures count per test file and exclude cloud workspace errors.

cases.title: reads CRLF output
cases.reason: CRLF compiler output remains parseable.

cases.title: fails when a file gains an error, as a missing helper import does
cases.reason: Real temporary baseline causes increased per-file errors to fail.

cases.title: passes at the baseline and fails until a fixed file is pruned
cases.reason: Fixed files must be pruned and the updated actual baseline passes afterward.

rationale: Retain diagnostic parsing and baseline prune behavior, including platform line endings.

cases.title: counts calls and value uses of the deleted helpers, not definitions, types or imports
cases.reason: Forbidden helper uses distinguish runtime calls/value uses from declarations/imports/types.

cases.title: counts setting reads, the helpers and the creation default together
cases.reason: Setting reads and sanctioned creation-default calls are counted together.

cases.title: discovers readers through imports, so a look-alike or a wrapper lowers nothing
cases.reason: Multi-file reader discovery follows returned imports/wrappers without confusing unrelated same-named functions or components.

cases.title: counts a reader called through a namespace or dynamic import
cases.reason: Namespace and dynamic-import variants cannot hide focused-host reader calls.

cases.title: discovers a reader assigned to a local that is then returned
cases.reason: Assign-then-return flow propagates reader ownership while discarded side effects do not.

cases.title: stops an arrow result before the next argument without losing nested reader results
cases.reason: Arrow expression boundaries do not absorb unrelated callback arguments or lose nested returned readers.

cases.title: counts the default scope source as a read
cases.reason: Default scope source is itself focused-host routing evidence.

cases.title: counts a wrapper that returns a seed reader's result
cases.reason: Wrapper returning a seeded reader cannot escape discovery.

cases.title: counts destructuring reads
cases.reason: Destructuring and aliases count as actual focus-setting reads.

cases.title: does not count writes, keys, props or type positions
cases.reason: Writes, object keys, props and type positions do not inflate the migration ratchet.

cases.title: refuses an aliased import or re-export, which would hide its calls
cases.reason: Aliased helper imports/reexports cannot conceal later calls from name-based routing checks.

cases.title: scans renderer sources but not tests
cases.reason: Test fixtures are excluded while shipped TS/TSX source remains scanned.

rationale: Retain focus-routing scanner regressions: distinct positive/negative AST-like source forms protect remote resource ownership.

cases.title: counts JSX drawn straight from a host collection
cases.reason: Host/SSH/target collection JSX maps are detected with different callback forms.

cases.title: ignores bounded rows, data maps and comments
cases.reason: Bounded shown rows, data transformations and commented source avoid false positives.

cases.title: scans renderer components outside the host-picker primitive
cases.reason: Host-picker primitive and test files stay excluded while renderer components stay scanned.

rationale: Retain small positive and negative scanner fixtures for the bounded-host-list performance ratchet.

cases.title: lists public writes whose first parameter is an id by name, whatever its type
cases.reason: Concrete method signatures verify host-target discrimination, public-write identification and parameter/type handling.

cases.title: stays inside the named class
cases.reason: Class boundary and absent-class behavior are independently expected.

cases.title: scans every Store operations class and skips the documented exemptions
cases.reason: The census can pass with an empty returned write list, repeats the production filter exemptions, and pins an arbitrary >10 class count; actual repository ratchet runs in CI and parser/discovery cases remain.

cases.title: flags a repo-row lookup by id alone (review-5 #10), by its enclosing function
cases.reason: Id-only repo predicates are distinguished from host-qualified lookup and assigned the enclosing declaration.

cases.title: finds an operations class whose import also brings in a function
cases.reason: Synthetic store composition catches mixed function/class imports and returns actual expected operation class paths.

rationale: Remove current-tree census that only checks an arbitrary class-count threshold and absence of the implementation own exemption list; keep meaningful parser/discovery fixtures.

cases.title: parses candidate files once and reports violations from both guards
cases.reason: Real source is parsed once yet violations from both independent boundary guards are reported.

cases.title: uses fresh inputs on every invocation, including newly added files
cases.reason: Newly added production files are scanned on the next invocation.

cases.title: does not cache a file across an edit at the same path
cases.reason: Editing one path invalidates parsing rather than reusing stale import evidence.

cases.title: rejects malformed source and missing package implementations
cases.reason: Invalid syntax and absent public package implementation cannot produce a passing boundary gate.

rationale: Retain actual multi-guard integration, per-invocation input freshness and parse/implementation failure behavior.
